pages.text: $(bold)Indestructible$() (tinkersnewlife:indestructible, Durandal default trait)$(br2)Effect: the tool $(bold)never loses durability$() and never breaks.$(br2)⚠ Unlike vanilla Tinkers' $(italic)Unbreakable$(): $(bold)it has no prerequisites$() (Unbreakable normally requires Reinforced V + Netherite before it can be modified), so tools with this trait can be upgraded normally.
